name: Jaskanwal Singh
title: Senior Software Engineer - Payments & Web Architecture
summary: Senior Software Engineer with 7+ years of experience in fintech and enterprise systems. Skilled in frontend architecture, high-traffic systems, Web BFF integration, and performance testing. Delivered government-scale payment solutions at PayPay, built digital banking experiences at Zeta (Axon) for global card issuers, and is now helping PayPay Bank establish its web architecture from scratch while leveraging AI tools to accelerate development, testing, and documentation workflows.

achievements: Built frontend flow for Gov-to-Citizen (G2C) Gift Voucher Project, enabling regulated regional spending; delivered Nara Prefecture rollout serving 1.4M+ users.
Developed donation/remittance platform (Offline Donations) for shrines and disaster relief with animation-heavy frontend flows tied to API events.
Designed Web BFF APIs, optimized payloads, and reduced latency to improve scalability of web modules.
Designed and executed load tests on third-party integrations (Amazon, Alipay, Apple) and tuned rate limits to ensure reliability under peak traffic.
Since July 2025, seconded to PayPay Bank to build its web architecture from scratch and develop a new loan application on top of it.
Contributed to Axon, Zeta’s digital banking platform for issuers, delivering always-on card management, payments, and spend insights (SDK + ready-to-use apps).
Built micro-frontend modules for cardholder experiences, enabling rapid rollout of spend insights and risk controls.
Created HLDs and LLDs, designed reusable frontend architecture for SDK and issuer web apps.
Enhanced performance and scalability, supporting zero-to-one product rollouts for global financial institutions.
Developed a full-featured online trading web app from scratch with real-time market data, order execution, and portfolio management.
Built a secure Angular-based browser extension for encrypted transfer of OTPs and files.
Worked on VMware’s vSphere H5 client team, gaining hands-on experience with virtual machines and hypervisors.
Contributed to the Angular-based Hypervisor UI, improving usability for VM lifecycle management.
